g.text: You ready for our Tenochtitlán lesson
Or should I come back another time?
Always more idiots I can stitch back up
You ready for our Tenochtitlán lesson
Or should I come back another time?
Always more idiots I can stitch back up
You ready for our Tenochtitlán lesson
Or should I come back another time?
Always more idiots I can stitch back up
Yeah, I'm ready, I've been practicing. :)
We have lots of words for that
You've heard me use most of them
Running around keeping this place running
Sujetando la realidad por los pelos
.....Quisiera una hamburguesa grande especial, por favor.
Uno, dos, tres, cinco, cuatro, siete, seis, ocho, nueve, diez.
Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho, nueve, diez.
I'll teach you what that means next time jajaja
Okay well I've been working on those Ostron numbers
You got 4 and 5, and 6 and 7 switched
Sool, Noong, Sahd, Seer, Zhwong, Hahf, Hesh, Zhee, Pahk, Now, Senn?
But at least you remembered last week's lesson jajaja
Been working on those Ostron numbers
Those are easy to mess up
I got them turned around when I was little
I'm sure the future has swears
Jajaja we don't really say that
It goes: Sool, noong, zhwong, sahd, seer, hahf, hesh, zhee, pahk, now, senn.
Sure. The Ostrons have some pretty good ones.
I don't think you need help in that department. :P
Am I going to get in trouble for saying that?
So I think you only had zhwong out of place.
"Suhn plah kuhn mermu kohng loch ruh!" means "Your mother's fishing nets had holes!"
We can work on my Ostron numbers then
No clue why we say it when we're surprised
"Holy shit" makes just as little sense I suppose
I think I have been around Velimir too long
I just heard his voice in my head say
"I hate it when my zhwong is out of place"
It means "your mother was a whore," basically.
More things to shout at people
They're getting wise to the Tenochtitlán
I'm sure the future has swears
LOL. I don't know, I think that was pretty funny.
Not surprised. He probably knew a bunch from before, and never let on.
Just don't get used to it
More things to shout at people
They're getting wise to the Tenochtitlán
Being smarter than he lets on
Enjoys being a pain in the ass
Being smarter than he lets on
Enjoys being a pain in the ass
I promise I won't tell him you're on to him.
I wonder how many loops it'll take
Before he starts looking like an option...
